jp: 食べられず捨てられた南瓜の怨念が集まり再度南瓜の形を形成して生まれた。そのせいか、食べても南瓜の味がしない。１０月になるとテンションが上がり、笑顔が絶えなくなる。
jp_grezzo: "食べられず捨てられた南瓜の怨念が集まり再度南瓜の形を形成して生まれた。そのせいか、食べても南瓜の味がしない。１０月になるとテンションが上がり、笑顔が絶えなくなる。"
en: It was born when the grudges of pumpkins that were thrown away because they were not eaten gathered together to form the shape of a pumpkin again. Perhaps that's why it doesn't taste like a pumpkin when you eat it. in October, tension rises and the smile never ceases to grow.
en_grezzo: "It was born when the grudges of pumpkins that were thrown away because they were not eaten gathered together to form the shape of a pumpkin again. Perhaps that's why it doesn't taste like a pumpkin when you eat it. in October, tension rises and the smile never ceases to grow."
it: È nato quando il rancore delle zucche buttate via senza essere mangiate si è raccolto e ha ripreso la forma di una zucca. Sarà per questo che, a mangiarlo, di zucca non sa. In ottobre gli sale l'entusiasmo e il sorriso non gli si spegne mai.

jp: 闇に葬られた、望まれなかった子供達の怨念の集合体。自分と同じ境遇のモノを取り込んでは、闇に紛れてその恨みを次々と晴らしてゆく。
jp_grezzo: "闇に葬られた、望まれなかった子供達の怨念の集合体。自分と同じ境遇のモノを取り込んでは、闇に紛れてその恨みを次々と晴らしてゆく。"
en: An aggregate of the grudges of unwanted children buried in the darkness. They take in those in the same situation as themselves, and then, in the darkness, clear out their resentment one after the other.
en_grezzo: "An aggregate of the grudges of unwanted children buried in the darkness. They take in those in the same situation as themselves, and then, in the darkness, clear out their resentment one after the other."
it: L'ammasso dei rancori dei bambini indesiderati, sepolti nel buio. Assorbe chi ha avuto la sua stessa sorte e, confondendosi con il buio, si toglie quelle voglie una dopo l'altra.

jp: 闇に葬られた、かつては仙人と呼ばれたこともあった老人の怨念。生前習得した気配を消す法は衰えておらず、生半な冒険者では捉えることもできないだろう。
jp_grezzo: "闇に葬られた、かつては仙人と呼ばれたこともあった老人の怨念。生前習得した気配を消す法は衰えておらず、生半な冒険者では捉えることもできないだろう。"
en: The grudge of an old man, once called a hermit, buried in darkness. The methods he mastered during his life for eliminating signs have not diminished, and no half-hearted adventurer will be able to capture them.
en_grezzo: "The grudge of an old man, once called a hermit, buried in darkness. The methods he mastered during his life for eliminating signs have not diminished, and no half-hearted adventurer will be able to capture them."
it: Il rancore di un vecchio sepolto nel buio, che un tempo qualcuno aveva chiamato eremita. L'arte di cancellare la propria presenza, imparata da vivo, non si è indebolita, e un avventuriero mediocre non riuscirà nemmeno a stanarlo.

jp: かつては迷宮を支配していたという巨人。火の巨人だから多少寒くても大丈夫だろうという理屈で雪の降る中、防寒具も与えてもらえずにいつも震えている。
jp_grezzo: "かつては迷宮を支配していたという巨人。火の巨人だから多少寒くても大丈夫だろうという理屈で雪の降る中、防寒具も与えてもらえずにいつも震えている。"
en: A giant who used to rule the labyrinth. He is always shivering in the snowy weather without being given any warm clothing, on the theory that he is a fire giant so he should be fine even if it is a little cold.
en_grezzo: "A giant who used to rule the labyrinth. He is always shivering in the snowy weather without being given any warm clothing, on the theory that he is a fire giant so he should be fine even if it is a little cold."
it: Un gigante che un tempo, dicono, dominava il labirinto. Con il ragionamento che, essendo un gigante di fuoco, un po' di freddo lo reggerà, lo lasciano sotto la neve senza dargli nemmeno di che coprirsi, e lui trema sempre.

jp: ベロンの迷宮の主であった巨人を買い取り見世物にしている。管理がずさんなためイタズラで巨人を解き放たれ、結果、真っ先に燃やされることが多い。
jp_grezzo: "ベロンの迷宮の主であった巨人を買い取り見世物にしている。管理がずさんなためイタズラで巨人を解き放たれ、結果、真っ先に燃やされることが多い。"
en: He buys the giants that used to be the masters of the Belon labyrinth and makes a spectacle of them. Due to sloppy management, the giants are often unleashed as a prank and, as a result, he is often the first to be burnt.
en_grezzo: "He buys the giants that used to be the masters of the Belon labyrinth and makes a spectacle of them. Due to sloppy management, the giants are often unleashed as a prank and, as a result, he is often the first to be burnt."
it: Compra i giganti che erano padroni del labirinto di Belon e li mette in mostra. Li tiene con tanta trascuratezza che qualcuno per scherzo glieli libera, e il risultato è che il primo a essere bruciato è quasi sempre lui.

jp: 最近の安売りの結果、質の低下が懸念されている。なお、イルヴァでは男性であってもメイドと呼ぶ。どんな屈強な冒険者であろうと、主人が会うと言うまで玄関に入らせない気丈さを持つ。
jp_grezzo: "最近の安売りの結果、質の低下が懸念されている。なお、イルヴァでは男性であってもメイドと呼ぶ。どんな屈強な冒険者であろうと、主人が会うと言うまで玄関に入らせない気丈さを持つ。"
en: There is concern that quality is declining as a result of recent cheapening. In Irva, even men are called maids. No matter how strong the adventurer, they have the determination not to let their master enter the doorway until he says he will see them.
en_grezzo: "There is concern that quality is declining as a result of recent cheapening. In Irva, even men are called maids. No matter how strong the adventurer, they have the determination not to let their master enter the doorway until he says he will see them."
it: Da quando le svendono, si teme che la qualità stia calando. Da notare che in Irva si chiama domestica anche un uomo. Per quanto sia robusto l'avventuriero, ha il fegato di non lasciarlo entrare in casa finché il padrone non dice che lo riceve.

jp: 追加武装で機動力と防御力が向上しており、プチなのにエリート機械兵より戦力になる場合も多い。迷子にならないよう、行軍の際はジョイントを用いて列車のように連結走行する。
jp_grezzo: "追加武装で機動力と防御力が向上しており、プチなのにエリート機械兵より戦力になる場合も多い。迷子にならないよう、行軍の際はジョイントを用いて列車のように連結走行する。"
en: Additional armaments improve their mobility and defence, and they are often more powerful than elite machine soldiers, despite being petit. To prevent them from getting lost, they use joints when marching and run like a train.
en_grezzo: "Additional armaments improve their mobility and defence, and they are often more powerful than elite machine soldiers, despite being petit. To prevent them from getting lost, they use joints when marching and run like a train."
it: Con l'armamento aggiuntivo la mobilità e la difesa sono cresciute, e capita spesso che, pur essendo un putit, valga in battaglia più di un soldato meccanico scelto. Per non perdersi, quando marciano si agganciano con dei giunti e corrono in fila come un treno.

jp: 無邪気で素直なため、知らない人についていってしまう。悪い冒険者にひどい目に遭わされることもあるが、それでも今日もついていく。その先に待つ運命は…。
jp_grezzo: "無邪気で素直なため、知らない人についていってしまう。悪い冒険者にひどい目に遭わされることもあるが、それでも今日もついていく。その先に待つ運命は…。"
en: Innocent and straightforward, she run around and follows strangers. Sometimes she is badly beaten up by bad adventurers, but she still follows them to this day. What fate awaits her in the future...
en_grezzo: "Innocent and straightforward, she run around and follows strangers. Sometimes she is badly beaten up by bad adventurers, but she still follows them to this day. What fate awaits her in the future..."
it: È ingenua e docile, e così segue chiunque, anche chi non conosce. Ogni tanto un avventuriero cattivo le fa passare dei brutti momenti, eppure anche oggi va dietro a qualcuno. E il destino che l'aspetta più avanti...

jp: 母親がエーテル病に罹患してしまい、その看病に明け暮れる内に同年代の子と遊ぶ機会を逃し孤立してしまった。母親のことを他の何よりも優先する。
jp_grezzo: "母親がエーテル病に罹患してしまい、その看病に明け暮れる内に同年代の子と遊ぶ機会を逃し孤立してしまった。母親のことを他の何よりも優先する。"
en: Her mother contracted ether disease, and while she spent all her time looking after her, she missed the opportunity to play with children her own age and became isolated. She puts her mother above all else.
en_grezzo: "Her mother contracted ether disease, and while she spent all her time looking after her, she missed the opportunity to play with children her own age and became isolated. She puts her mother above all else."
it: Alla madre è venuta la malattia dell'etere, e a furia di passare le giornate ad accudirla ha perso le occasioni di giocare con i bambini della sua età, e si è ritrovata sola. La madre viene prima di ogni altra cosa.

jp: 夫がプチに食べられてしまったため女手一つで一人娘を育てていた。だが、人一倍エーテルに免疫がなかったようである日エーテル病で倒れてしまう。
jp_grezzo: "夫がプチに食べられてしまったため女手一つで一人娘を育てていた。だが、人一倍エーテルに免疫がなかったようである日エーテル病で倒れてしまう。"
en: She was raising her only daughter by herself after her husband was eaten by putits. However, she was not immune to the ether as much as other people, and one day she fell ill with ether disease.
en_grezzo: "She was raising her only daughter by herself after her husband was eaten by putits. However, she was not immune to the ether as much as other people, and one day she fell ill with ether disease."
it: Il marito se l'è mangiato un putit, e da allora tirava su la figlia unica con le sue sole forze. Ma pare che all'etere fosse meno resistente di chiunque altro, perché un giorno è caduta malata della malattia dell'etere.

jp: ポート・カプールの好色男。幼少時母親の愛を得られなかった気の毒な過去があり、母の面影を人妻の中に探している。同情する人も多いが、迷惑なエロオヤジであることに変わりはない。
jp_grezzo: "ポート・カプールの好色男。幼少時母親の愛を得られなかった気の毒な過去があり、母の面影を人妻の中に探している。同情する人も多いが、迷惑なエロオヤジであることに変わりはない。"
en: Port Kapul's womanizer. He has a tragic backstory of not having the love of his mother when he was a child and looks for her in married women. Many people sympathise with him, but he remains an annoying, erotic old man.
en_grezzo: "Port Kapul's womanizer. He has a tragic backstory of not having the love of his mother when he was a child and looks for her in married women. Many people sympathise with him, but he remains an annoying, erotic old man."
it: Il libertino di Porto Kapul. Ha un passato triste, senza l'amore della madre da bambino, e in ogni donna sposata cerca il volto di lei. In molti lo compatiscono, ma resta comunque un vecchio sporcaccione e molesto.

jp: 一度はちゃんと討伐対象に挑んだのだが、昇格試験の緊張からくるストレスで惨敗した。現在はイークがトラウマになっており、眠るたびに悪夢にうなされる。
jp_grezzo: "一度はちゃんと討伐対象に挑んだのだが、昇格試験の緊張からくるストレスで惨敗した。現在はイークがトラウマになっており、眠るたびに悪夢にうなされる。"
en: Once he properly challenged the target for elimination, but failed miserably due to the stress caused by the strain of the promotion exam. He is now traumatised by the yeeks and has nightmares every time he sleeps.
en_grezzo: "Once he properly challenged the target for elimination, but failed miserably due to the stress caused by the strain of the promotion exam. He is now traumatised by the yeeks and has nightmares every time he sleeps."
it: Una volta il bersaglio da abbattere lo ha affrontato per davvero, ma la tensione dell'esame di promozione gli ha messo addosso uno stress tale che ne è uscito con una sconfitta rovinosa. Adesso gli yeek sono il suo trauma, e ogni volta che dorme fa gli incubi.

jp: カミカゼ特攻隊の猛攻により負傷した。その時の怪我はとっくに治ったのだが、配置転換で今度は変異種討伐に駆り出されるようになり怪我が絶えない。
jp_grezzo: "カミカゼ特攻隊の猛攻により負傷した。その時の怪我はとっくに治ったのだが、配置転換で今度は変異種討伐に駆り出されるようになり怪我が絶えない。"
en: He was injured in the onslaught of the Kamikaze suicide attack. His injuries at the time had long since healed, but he was reassigned and this time he was sent to defeat mutants, which resulted in constant injuries.
en_grezzo: "He was injured in the onslaught of the Kamikaze suicide attack. His injuries at the time had long since healed, but he was reassigned and this time he was sent to defeat mutants, which resulted in constant injuries."
it: Si è ferito sotto l'assalto furioso del reparto suicida dei kamikaze. Quelle ferite lì sono guarite da un pezzo, ma con un cambio di destinazione adesso lo mandano ad abbattere le specie mutate, e le ferite non gli finiscono mai.

jp: 猫が大好きであるということと同じくらい、ぶりっ子であるということが有名。その本性は…おや？こんな時間に誰か来たみたいだ。
jp_grezzo: "猫が大好きであるということと同じくらい、ぶりっ子であるということが有名。その本性は…おや？こんな時間に誰か来たみたいだ。"
en: As much as she loves cats, she is famous for being a bratty girl. Her true nature is... oh? Someone is knocking on my door.
en_grezzo: "As much as she loves cats, she is famous for being a bratty girl. Her true nature is... oh? Someone is knocking on my door."
it: Tanto quanto è famosa per amare i gatti, è famosa per fare la svenevole. La sua vera natura è... oh? Pare sia arrivato qualcuno, a quest'ora.

jp: 夢破れた妹の自害がきっかけで精神を病んでしまった。気晴らしに美しいルミエストの景色を観たり、パーティーに参加するなどして静養中。
jp_grezzo: "夢破れた妹の自害がきっかけで精神を病んでしまった。気晴らしに美しいルミエストの景色を観たり、パーティーに参加するなどして静養中。"
en: She suffered a mental breakdown after the suicide of her younger sister, whose dreams were dashed. She is on a retreat, watching the beautiful Lumiest scenery and attending parties as a distraction.
en_grezzo: "She suffered a mental breakdown after the suicide of her younger sister, whose dreams were dashed. She is on a retreat, watching the beautiful Lumiest scenery and attending parties as a distraction. "
it: Il suicidio della sorella minore, con i suoi sogni infranti, gli ha fatto ammalare la mente. Adesso è a riposo, e per distrarsi guarda i bei paesaggi di Lumiest e va alle feste.

jp: 盗めぬものは無いとまで称された稀代の大泥棒。祖父マークスもまた高名な泥棒であったため、彼は三代目マークスに当たる。父親から言わせればまだ半人前であるらしく、半分になった仮面をつけさせられている。
jp_grezzo: "盗めぬものは無いとまで称された稀代の大泥棒。祖父マークスもまた高名な泥棒であったため、彼は三代目マークスに当たる。父親から言わせればまだ半人前であるらしく、半分になった仮面をつけさせられている。"
en: A thief of rare distinction, he was even described as a thief who could steal anything. He is the third Marks, as his grandfather Marks was also a renowned thief. He is forced to wear a mask that has been cut in half, as he is still only half a man in his father's eyes.
en_grezzo: "A thief of rare distinction, he was even described as a thief who could steal anything. He is the third Marks, as his grandfather Marks was also a renowned thief. He is forced to wear a mask that has been cut in half, as he is still only half a man in his father's eyes."
it: Un ladro di razza rara, di cui si diceva che non ci fosse niente che non sapesse rubare. Anche il nonno Marks era un ladro famoso, e quindi lui è il terzo Marks. A sentire il padre non vale ancora un uomo intero, e per questo gli tocca portare una maschera tagliata a metà.

jp: 彼女の人生は常に爆炎に彩られており、今や本能的に炎を求めている。いつかすべてを爆炎に包み込むため、彼女は今日も爆弾を作る。
jp_grezzo: "彼女の人生は常に爆炎に彩られており、今や本能的に炎を求めている。いつかすべてを爆炎に包み込むため、彼女は今日も爆弾を作る。"
en: Her life has always been coloured by the flames of explosions and she now instinctively seeks fire. She makes bombs today in order to one day engulf everything in flames.
en_grezzo: "Her life has always been coloured by the flames of explosions and she now instinctively seeks fire. She makes bombs today in order to one day engulf everything in flames."
it: La sua vita è sempre stata dipinta di fiamme d'esplosione, e ormai il fuoco lo cerca d'istinto. Per avvolgere un giorno ogni cosa in una fiammata, anche oggi costruisce bombe.

jp: パルミアの国防を憂いている生真面目な軍人。見込んだ冒険者に、危険分子の討伐を依頼している。かなり怒りっぽいので部下からは恐れられている。
jp_grezzo: "パルミアの国防を憂いている生真面目な軍人。見込んだ冒険者に、危険分子の討伐を依頼している。かなり怒りっぽいので部下からは恐れられている。"
en: A serious soldier who is concerned about Palmia's national security. He asks adventurers he sees to help him defeat dangerous individuals. He is feared by his subordinates because he has a very angry temper.
en_grezzo: "A serious soldier who is concerned about Palmia's national security. He asks adventurers he sees to help him defeat dangerous individuals. He is feared by his subordinates because he has a very angry temper."
it: Un militare serissimo, in pena per la difesa di Palmia. Agli avventurieri su cui punta affida l'incarico di abbattere gli elementi pericolosi. Si arrabbia con facilità, e i sottoposti lo temono.

jp: ケチなスリの見習い。どんな職種であれ、下積みというのは辛いものである。自らの腕に自信が無いのか、一度スった後でも確認のため再度戻ってきてしまう間抜け。
jp_grezzo: "ケチなスリの見習い。どんな職種であれ、下積みというのは辛いものである。自らの腕に自信が無いのか、一度スった後でも確認のため再度戻ってきてしまう間抜け。"
en: Stingy pickpocket apprenticeship. No matter what type of work you do, it's hard to get an apprenticeship. He is a fool who, perhaps lacking confidence in his own skills, returns to check on the result after he has already done the job.
en_grezzo: "Stingy pickpocket apprenticeship. No matter what type of work you do, it's hard to get an apprenticeship. He is a fool who, perhaps lacking confidence in his own skills, returns to check on the result after he has already done the job."
it: Un apprendista borsaiolo da quattro soldi. In qualunque mestiere, la gavetta è una cosa dura. Sarà che della propria mano non si fida, ma dopo aver svuotato una tasca torna indietro a controllare: un babbeo.

jp: 力に物を言わせて金を強奪する、ピンの盗賊。強引に金を奪い取っては、まだ持っているだろうとしつこく付きまとってくるため、かなり鬱陶しい。
jp_grezzo: "力に物を言わせて金を強奪する、ピンの盗賊。強引に金を奪い取っては、まだ持っているだろうとしつこく付きまとってくるため、かなり鬱陶しい。"
en: Bandit who uses force to extort gold. They are quite annoying, as they forcefully take the money and then persistently follow you to see if you still have it.
en_grezzo: "Bandit who uses force to extort gold. They are quite annoying, as they forcefully take the money and then persistently follow you to see if you still have it. "
it: Un ladro di infimo rango, che si prende i soldi facendo parlare la forza. Ti strappa via il denaro con le brutte e poi ti sta dietro insistendo che qualcosa devi ancora avere, e la cosa è parecchio molesta.

jp: 数々の経験を積んだ盗みのプロフェッショナル。盗みで手に入れた怪しげな商品を売り続けた結果、非常に口が上手い。
jp_grezzo: "数々の経験を積んだ盗みのプロフェッショナル。盗みで手に入れた怪しげな商品を売り続けた結果、非常に口が上手い。"
en: Professional thief with numerous experiences. Very well-spoken as a result of continually selling dubious goods obtained by stealing.
en_grezzo: "Professional thief with numerous experiences. Very well-spoken as a result of continually selling dubious goods obtained by stealing. "
it: Un professionista del furto, con parecchie esperienze alle spalle. A furia di rivendere la merce sospetta che si procura rubando, ha imparato a parlare benissimo.

jp: 別の惑星から到来した精神生命体。現在はイルヴァに生息していた円錐生命体の肉体を乗っ取っており、その天敵たる種族を地中深くに封じているという。
jp_grezzo: "別の惑星から到来した精神生命体。現在はイルヴァに生息していた円錐生命体の肉体を乗っ取っており、その天敵たる種族を地中深くに封じているという。"
en: A spirit life-form that arrived from another planet. It is said to have taken over the body of a conical life-form that currently inhabits Irva and has sealed its natural enemy species deep underground.
en_grezzo: "A spirit life-form that arrived from another planet. It is said to have taken over the body of a conical life-form that currently inhabits Irva and has sealed its natural enemy species deep underground."
it: Una forma di vita spirituale arrivata da un altro pianeta. Adesso si è impadronita del corpo delle creature coniche che abitavano in Irva, e si dice tenga sigillata nel profondo della terra la stirpe che le è nemica.

jp: 千の仔を孕みし森の黒山羊とも呼ばれる異界の豊穣の母神。クミロミとの激闘の末に撤退した過去があり、現在は弱々しい分身を送り込んでは様子見をしている。
jp_grezzo: "千の仔を孕みし森の黒山羊とも呼ばれる異界の豊穣の母神。クミロミとの激闘の末に撤退した過去があり、現在は弱々しい分身を送り込んでは様子見をしている。"
en: The fertility mother goddess of the Otherworld, also known as the Black Goat of the Forest, who conceives a thousand pups. She has a history of withdrawing after a fierce battle with Kumiromi, and currently sends her weak alter ego to watch over her.
en_grezzo: "The fertility mother goddess of the Otherworld, also known as the Black Goat of the Forest, who conceives a thousand pups. She has a history of withdrawing after a fierce battle with Kumiromi, and currently sends her weak alter ego to watch over her."
it: La dea madre della fertilità di un altro mondo, che chiamano anche la capra nera dei boschi dai mille figli. In passato, dopo uno scontro furioso con Kumiromi, si è ritirata, e adesso manda avanti dei suoi doppioni deboli e sta a guardare.

jp: 神々の怒りに触れ地底に追放された巨人。狭い地底での暮らしに適応した結果、再び地上に戻ってきたときにはやや小柄になっていた。
jp_grezzo: "神々の怒りに触れ地底に追放された巨人。狭い地底での暮らしに適応した結果、再び地上に戻ってきたときにはやや小柄になっていた。"
en: A giant who was banished to the depths of underground when he incurred the wrath of the gods. As a result of adapting to life in the narrow subterranean depths, they became somewhat smaller when they returned to the surface.
en_grezzo: "A giant who was banished to the depths of underground when he incurred the wrath of the gods. As a result of adapting to life in the narrow subterranean depths, they became somewhat smaller when they returned to the surface."
it: Un gigante scacciato nelle viscere della terra per aver toccato la collera delle divinità. A furia di adattarsi alla vita stretta del sottosuolo, quando è tornato in superficie si era fatto un po' più piccolo.

jp: 遥かな過去、邪教徒として弾圧され火刑に死した異教の聖母子。邪神と蔑まれた神が二人の怨念に螺旋の力を加え、恐ろしき魔物の王を作り出した。
jp_grezzo: "遥かな過去、邪教徒として弾圧され火刑に死した異教の聖母子。邪神と蔑まれた神が二人の怨念に螺旋の力を加え、恐ろしき魔物の王を作り出した。"
en: In the distant past, the pagan Virgin and Child were oppressed as pagans and died by fire. The god despised as an evil god added the power of the spiral to their grudge and created the dreaded King of Monsters.
en_grezzo: "In the distant past, the pagan Virgin and Child were oppressed as pagans and died by fire. The god despised as an evil god added the power of the spiral to their grudge and created the dreaded King of Monsters."
it: In un passato remoto, una madre e un figlio di una fede straniera, perseguitati come eretici, morirono sul rogo. Il dio che disprezzavano come dio malvagio aggiunse al rancore dei due la forza della spirale, e creò un re dei mostri spaventoso.

jp: 自由気ままな野良妖精。通りがかった旅人に幻覚を見せて混乱させたり、財布を盗んだりする。相手が慌てふためいた姿を眺めるのが趣味。
jp_grezzo: "自由気ままな野良妖精。通りがかった旅人に幻覚を見せて混乱させたり、財布を盗んだりする。相手が慌てふためいた姿を眺めるのが趣味。"
en: Free-spirited stray fairy. She confuses passer-by travellers with illusions and steals their wallets. Enjoys watching them panic.
en_grezzo: "Free-spirited stray fairy. She confuses passer-by travellers with illusions and steals their wallets. Enjoys watching them panic."
it: Una fata randagia, libera e capricciosa. Al viandante che passa mostra allucinazioni per confonderlo, oppure gli ruba il borsellino. Il suo passatempo è guardarlo mentre si agita.

jp: 富のヤカテクトの一部にしてその下僕。輝くような白い毛並みのガチョウで、満腹になるとプラチナ硬貨の入った卵を産む。体内にプラチナの塊などはない。
jp_grezzo: "富のヤカテクトの一部にしてその下僕。輝くような白い毛並みのガチョウで、満腹になるとプラチナ硬貨の入った卵を産む。体内にプラチナの塊などはない。"
en: A part of the Yacatect of Wealth and her servant. A goose with shining white fur, it lays eggs filled with platinum coins when it is full. There are no platinum lumps in its body.
en_grezzo: "A part of the Yacatect of Wealth and her servant. A goose with shining white fur, it lays eggs filled with platinum coins when it is full. There are no platinum lumps in its body."
it: Una parte di Yacatect della ricchezza e insieme il suo servo. È un'oca dal piumaggio bianco e splendente, e quando è sazia depone uova con dentro monete di platino. Blocchi di platino, nel corpo, non ne ha.

jp: 幸運のエヘカトルの一部にしてその下僕。光沢のある漆黒の毛が艶めかしい黒猫。この猫に舐められた武具は、エヘカトルの祝福を受けて新たな力を授かるという。
jp_grezzo: "幸運のエヘカトルの一部にしてその下僕。光沢のある漆黒の毛が艶めかしい黒猫。この猫に舐められた武具は、エヘカトルの祝福を受けて新たな力を授かるという。"
en: A part of the Ehekatl of Luck and her servant. A lustrous black cat with shiny jet-black fur. It is said that any armour licked by this cat is blessed by Ehekatl and given new powers.
en_grezzo: "A part of the Ehekatl of Luck and her servant. A lustrous black cat with shiny jet-black fur. It is said that any armour licked by this cat is blessed by Ehekatl and given new powers."
it: Una parte di Ehekatl della fortuna e insieme il suo servo. È un gatto nero dal pelo corvino e lucente, di una bellezza sfrontata. Si dice che l'arma o l'armatura leccata da questo gatto riceva la benedizione di Ehekatl e un potere nuovo.

jp: 収穫のクミロミの一部にしてその下僕。おとぎ話から抜け出たような姿の妖精さん。食物を転生させ作物の種を生み出す。
jp_grezzo: "収穫のクミロミの一部にしてその下僕。おとぎ話から抜け出たような姿の妖精さん。食物を転生させ作物の種を生み出す。"
en: Part of the Kumiromi of Harvest and his servant. A fairy who looks like something out of a fairy tale. Reincarnates food and produces crop seeds.
en_grezzo: "Part of the Kumiromi of Harvest and his servant. A fairy who looks like something out of a fairy tale. Reincarnates food and produces crop seeds."
it: Una parte di Kumiromi del raccolto e insieme il suo servo. È una fatina che sembra uscita da una fiaba. Fa rinascere il cibo e ne ricava i semi delle colture.

jp: 機械のマニの一部にしてその下僕。マニによって改良がたびたび行われており、最新バージョンは頑丈な装甲を持つ。
jp_grezzo: "機械のマニの一部にしてその下僕。マニによって改良がたびたび行われており、最新バージョンは頑丈な装甲を持つ。"
en: A part of and servant of the Mani of Machines. It is frequently improved by Mani, with the latest versions having sturdier armour.
en_grezzo: "A part of and servant of the Mani of Machines. It is frequently improved by Mani, with the latest versions having sturdier armour."
it: Una parte di Mani della macchina e insieme il suo servo. Mani lo migliora di continuo, e la versione più recente ha una corazza robusta.

jp: 風のルルウィの一部にしてその下僕。黒い翼とドレスを身にまとった美しい天使だが、主に似てエロティックで、サディスティックで、エゴイスティック。
jp_grezzo: "風のルルウィの一部にしてその下僕。黒い翼とドレスを身にまとった美しい天使だが、主に似てエロティックで、サディスティックで、エゴイスティック。"
en: Part of Lulwy of Wind and her servant. A beautiful angel with black wings and dress, but like her Lord, she is erotic, sadistic and egotistical.
en_grezzo: "Part of Lulwy of Wind and her servant. A beautiful angel with black wings and dress, but like her Lord, she is erotic, sadistic and egotistical."
it: Una parte di Lulwy del vento e insieme il suo servo. È un angelo bellissimo, con le ali e l'abito neri, ma somiglia alla padrona: erotico, sadico ed egoista.

jp: 元素のイツパロトルの一部にしてその下僕。ローブを纏った魔法使い。元素魔法そっちのけで他属性の魔法を練習していたところ、怒りを買って追放された。
jp_grezzo: "元素のイツパロトルの一部にしてその下僕。ローブを纏った魔法使い。元素魔法そっちのけで他属性の魔法を練習していたところ、怒りを買って追放された。"
en: Part of the Itzpalt of Element and his servant. A robed wizard. When they practised magic of other attributes in preference to elemental magic, Itzpalt were angered, and they are banished.
en_grezzo: "Part of the Itzpalt of Element and his servant. A robed wizard. When they practised magic of other attributes in preference to elemental magic, Itzpalt were angered, and they are banished."
it: Una parte di Itzpalt degli elementi e insieme il suo servo. È un mago in veste lunga. Trascurava la magia degli elementi per esercitarsi in quella di altri attributi, si è tirato addosso l'ira del dio ed è stato scacciato.

jp: 地のオパートスの一部にしてその下僕。金そのもので出来た糸を紡いだような美しいブロンドの女性騎士。華奢な容姿からは想像もできないほどの膂力を持つ。
jp_grezzo: "地のオパートスの一部にしてその下僕。金そのもので出来た糸を紡いだような美しいブロンドの女性騎士。華奢な容姿からは想像もできないほどの膂力を持つ。"
en: Part of the Opatos of Earth and his servant. A beautiful blonde female knight who looks as if she were spun from a thread made of gold itself. She has a physical strength that is unimaginable from her slender appearance.
en_grezzo: "Part of the Opatos of Earth and his servant. A beautiful blonde female knight who looks as if she were spun from a thread made of gold itself. She has a physical strength that is unimaginable from her slender appearance."
it: Una parte di Opatos della terra e insieme il suo servo. È una cavaliera bionda e bellissima, come se l'avessero filata con un filo d'oro vero. Ha una forza nelle braccia che quel corpo esile non lascia nemmeno immaginare.

jp: 癒しのジュアの一部にしてその下僕。死の渕まで追いやられたとしても、その身をただ一枚の盾として仲間を守り続ける。
jp_grezzo: "癒しのジュアの一部にしてその下僕。死の渕まで追いやられたとしても、その身をただ一枚の盾として仲間を守り続ける。"
en: Part of the Jure of Healing and her servant. Even when driven to the brink of death, he continues to protect his friends with his body as the only shield.
en_grezzo: "Part of the Jure of Healing and her servant. Even when driven to the brink of death, he continues to protect his friends with his body as the only shield."
it: Una parte di Jure della guarigione e insieme il suo servo. Anche spinto sull'orlo della morte, continua a proteggere i compagni facendo del proprio corpo un unico scudo.

jp: どこかから脱走したと思しき野生化した雑種の馬。駄馬と嘲られてはいるが、乗馬技術の低い駆け出しの冒険者には最高の相棒になってくれるだろう。
jp_grezzo: "どこかから脱走したと思しき野生化した雑種の馬。駄馬と嘲られてはいるが、乗馬技術の低い駆け出しの冒険者には最高の相棒になってくれるだろう。"
en: A wild mongrel horse that seems to have escaped from somewhere. Although they are derided as spoiled horses, they would make excellent companions for fledgling adventurers with limited riding skills.
en_grezzo: "A wild mongrel horse that seems to have escaped from somewhere. Although they are derided as spoiled horses, they would make excellent companions for fledgling adventurers with limited riding skills."
it: Un cavallo bastardo tornato allo stato brado, che a quanto pare è scappato da qualche parte. Lo deridono come un ronzino, ma per un avventuriero alle prime armi, che di cavalcare non sa granché, sarà il compagno migliore.

jp: イルヴァに古くから居る野生の馬。この品種を元にノイエル馬やヨウィン馬等の改良種が多く作られており、全ての馬の原点とも言える。
jp_grezzo: "イルヴァに古くから居る野生の馬。この品種を元にノイエル馬やヨウィン馬等の改良種が多く作られており、全ての馬の原点とも言える。"
en: A wild horse that has been in the Irva for a long time. Many improved breeds, such as the Noyel horse and the Yowyn horse, have been created from this breed, and it can be said to be the origin of all horses.
en_grezzo: "A wild horse that has been in the Irva for a long time. Many improved breeds, such as the Noyel horse and the Yowyn horse, have been created from this breed, and it can be said to be the origin of all horses."
it: Il cavallo selvatico che vive in Irva da tempi antichi. Da questa razza ne hanno ricavate molte migliorate, come il cavallo di Noyel e quello di Yowyn, e si può dire che sia l'origine di tutti i cavalli.

jp: ノイエルの寒い気候に適応するように品種改良された馬。雪原を軽快に進めるように進化した脚は、野生の物より速く駆けることが出来るようになっている。
jp_grezzo: "ノイエルの寒い気候に適応するように品種改良された馬。雪原を軽快に進めるように進化した脚は、野生の物より速く駆けることが出来るようになっている。"
en: Horses bred to adapt to the cold climate of Noyel. Their legs have evolved to allow them to move nimbly through snowfields, and they can run faster than their wild counterparts.
en_grezzo: "Horses bred to adapt to the cold climate of Noyel. Their legs have evolved to allow them to move nimbly through snowfields, and they can run faster than their wild counterparts."
it: Un cavallo migliorato per adattarsi al clima freddo di Noyel. Le zampe si sono evolute per avanzare leggere sulla neve, e riescono a correre più veloci di quelle dei cavalli selvatici.

jp: ヨウィンで品種改良された馬。力も強く足も速いグレードの高い名馬としても知られているが、その肉も精がつく美味な食材として珍重されている。
jp_grezzo: "ヨウィンで品種改良された馬。力も強く足も速いグレードの高い名馬としても知られているが、その肉も精がつく美味な食材として珍重されている。"
en: A horse bred in Yowyn. They are known for their strength, strength and speed, and their meat is also prized as a tasty foodstuff that is good for the soul.
en_grezzo: "A horse bred in Yowyn. They are known for their strength, strength and speed, and their meat is also prized as a tasty foodstuff that is good for the soul."
it: Un cavallo migliorato a Yowyn. È noto come cavallo di razza pregiata, forte e veloce, ma anche la sua carne è ricercata come alimento saporito che rimette in forze.
